title: Why Your Relief Carving Takes Three Days, and How to Make It Three Hours
excerpt: A 20 by 12 inch relief on a single 1/8 inch ball nose can run for six days. The same panel with a roughing pass, a bit ladder and a boundary around the fine detail runs in an afternoon. The method, the maths and the settings.
seo_title: How Long Does CNC Relief Carving Take? Cut 3D Carving Time by 80%
seo_description: Why 3D relief carvings take days on a CNC router and how to cut the time by 80%: roughing passes, the bit ladder, stepover maths, finishing boundaries, feeds for hobby machines, and a time estimator.
